description: This PHP script sets up a testing environment for the OrangeHRM system by copying plugins, registering autoloaders, configuring services, and creating database savepoints.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: PHP's Composer autoloader for dynamically loading classes based on PSR-4 standards.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for OrangeHRM, holding constants for product mode, plugin directories, etc.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Service responsible for cache management within the system.

classes.name: Filesystem
classes.description: Utility class for filesystem operations such as symlinking and changing permissions.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Dependency injection container managing services like cache and ORM.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Service to manage database backup operations, in this case creating a savepoint.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: ORM documentation class providing access to Doctrine's EntityManager.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial savepoint in the database to facilitate testing rollback.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache object from CacheService.
